summary: Assistant Professor in the Department of Business Administration at St. Joseph's College (Autonomous), Tiruchirappalli, affiliated to Bharathidasan University, teaching in higher education since 2016. B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering, M.B.A. in Human Resource Management and Marketing, qualified UGC-NET and TNSET in Management, and a part-time Ph.D. scholar in Management Studies. Founder and trustee of TOSS Charitable Trust since 2009.

community: Through TOSS Charitable Trust I have helped build a network of more than 150 student and young-professional volunteers across three districts of Tamil Nadu. Its campaigns include the TOSS Talent Fest, a sports and cultural meet for differently-abled and special children now in its twelfth year; Operation Oxygen, a tree-planting programme; Clean Cauvery, a riverbank restoration campaign; Limitless, educational support for hearing-impaired learners; and street and school libraries.
